To protect the vault Cripta uses the phone\'s screen lock. Set a PIN, pattern or password (and, if you like, fingerprint or face) in the security settings, then come back here.

Files are encrypted on the phone with a key protected by the screen lock (fingerprint, face, PIN or pattern). Nobody, not even Cripta, can read them without you.
If you remove the screen lock, reset the phone or uninstall the app, the vault\'s files can no longer be recovered.
Make an encrypted backup regularly from Settings: it is the only way to get the files back on another phone.

The security key is no longer valid because the device\'s biometrics changed or the screen lock was removed. The protected data can no longer be recovered. You can reset the vault to start over. This can\'t be undone and deletes all the encrypted files.\n\nIf you made an encrypted backup, after the reset you can restore it from Settings → Backup with its passphrase.
